# Changelog

## Bulk archive clears the column at once

November 10, 2026 | Boards, Tasks

Selecting a whole column and pressing Ctrl+E now empties it immediately while the tickets archive in the background.

[Read more](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/2026-11-10-bulk-archive-clears-the-column-at-once-htpr-8928/)

## Summarize the current task now says what the task is first, then where it stands, then...

November 10, 2026 | Tasks

Improved: Summarize the current task now says what the task is first, then where it stands, then up to three open points. It does not open with a next action.

[Read more](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/2026-11-10-summarize-the-current-task-now-says-what-the-task-is-first-then-where-it-stands-then-944774c34a/)

## The Task Writer checks up to eight similar tickets before you save. When one is...

November 10, 2026 | Tasks

New: The Task Writer checks up to eight similar tickets before you save. When one is clearly the same work, your draft opens with Looks like may cover the same work, so you can merge or drop it.

[Read more](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/2026-11-10-the-task-writer-checks-up-to-eight-similar-tickets-before-you-save-when-one-is-d6f8291815/)

## Group table rows by tag

November 9, 2026 | Boards, Views

Table view can group rows by tag instead of only by column, so one screen can show the backlog split by topic.

[Read more](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/2026-11-09-group-table-rows-by-tag-htpr-8630/)

## Try the board with the AI chat already open

November 9, 2026 | AI Chat, Onboarding

A guest demo board now opens the AI chat for you on desktop, and a phone shows a Sign up button on the board so you can keep the work you just tried.

[Read more](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/2026-11-09-guest-board-chat-open-and-sign-up-htpr-7983/)

## An agent comment or new ticket is refused when it uses a dashed code name, quotes...

November 6, 2026 | AI, Tasks

Improved: An agent comment or new ticket is refused when it uses a dashed code name, quotes Valentin in plain quote marks, asks a Question in the wrong shape, or leaves out Problem, Fix, Done when, Risk, or Decision. People can still write those.

[Read more](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/2026-11-06-an-agent-comment-or-new-ticket-is-refused-when-it-uses-a-dashed-code-name-quotes-d82a290c3c/)

## When a provider rejects your own AI key, chat names that key instead of a generic...

November 6, 2026 | AI, Settings

Improved: When a provider rejects your own AI key, chat names that key instead of a generic error, and tells you to update it in Settings, under AI, Bring your own key.

[Read more](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/2026-11-06-when-a-provider-rejects-your-own-ai-key-chat-names-that-key-instead-of-a-generic-f3e0a0e5c0/)

## Board cards now line up in a tidier rhythm. An unmarked card has even padding with no...

November 3, 2026 | Board

Improved: Board cards now line up in a tidier rhythm. An unmarked card has even padding with no hidden stripe, a card you are working on or one marked as blocked keeps a single 4px stripe, card avatars are a little smaller, column titles sit on the same line as card text, and each column's scroll bar is a plain pill with no arrows.

[Read more](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/2026-11-03-board-cards-now-line-up-in-a-tidier-rhythm-an-unmarked-card-has-even-padding-with-no-13328106e0/)

## In the Ctrl+J new task box, Ctrl + Enter (Cmd + Enter on a Mac) now creates the task...

November 3, 2026 | Tasks

Improved: In the Ctrl+J new task box, Ctrl + Enter (Cmd + Enter on a Mac) now creates the task and Enter starts a new paragraph. The hint under the box shows the new shortcut.

[Read more](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/2026-11-03-in-the-ctrl-j-new-task-box-ctrl-enter-cmd-enter-on-a-mac-now-creates-the-task-60c01c663b/)

## Inbox rows use the whole line. The sender, ticket number and title sit together on the...

November 3, 2026 | Board, Tasks, Inbox

Improved: Inbox rows use the whole line. The sender, ticket number and title sit together on the left with no fixed name column, and the grey preview runs up to the tags, so a short sender no longer leaves an empty gap.

[Read more](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/2026-11-03-inbox-rows-use-the-whole-line-the-sender-ticket-number-and-title-sit-together-on-the-9d5f799ffa/)

## A New sub-task button in the sub-task window

November 3, 2026 | Tasks, Subtasks

Creating a sub-task no longer needs a name that matches nothing. A New sub-task button sits under the search box and opens the usual create window with the parent task already attached.

[Read more](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/2026-11-03-new-sub-task-button-htpr-8250/)

## The AI chat no longer opens by itself when you create a task. It opens when you open...

November 3, 2026 | AI, Tasks, Mobile, Settings

Improved: The AI chat no longer opens by itself when you create a task. It opens when you open it and stays as you left it, on desktop and phone.

[Read more](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/2026-11-03-the-ai-chat-no-longer-opens-by-itself-when-you-create-a-task-it-opens-when-you-open-a614584968/)

## The Ctrl+J New Task box now puts the microphone just left of a word Create button, and...

November 2, 2026 | AI, Tasks, Mobile

Improved: The Ctrl+J New Task box now puts the microphone just left of a word Create button, and a Dictation pill takes its place while you speak. The key hints under the box are written in words and switch while dictation runs: Ctrl Shift D starts and stops, Enter stops and keeps your words, Ctrl Enter stops and creates the ticket, Esc cancels.

[Read more](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/2026-11-02-the-ctrl-j-new-task-box-now-puts-the-microphone-just-left-of-a-word-create-button-and-6fca0f9071/)

## Agents follow, star and set a reminder on a ticket

October 31, 2026 | Agents, Tickets

An agent can now follow a ticket, star it and set a reminder on it, the same way a person can, and read its own state back.

[Read more](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/2026-10-31-agents-follow-star-remind-htpr-8217/)

## Agents share a ticket and read its public link

October 31, 2026 | Agents, Tickets

An agent can now make a ticket public, hand its client link to someone outside the team, and read back whether the ticket is public.

[Read more](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/2026-10-31-agents-share-a-ticket-htpr-8216/)

## After Ctrl+J creates a ticket, the AI chat sidebar now shows up to three one-tap chips...

October 30, 2026 | AI, Board, Tasks

Improved: After Ctrl+J creates a ticket, the AI chat sidebar now shows up to three one-tap chips with next actions or open decisions based on your original note and your board's rules, instead of questions about wording. When nothing fits, no chips appear.

[Read more](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/2026-10-30-after-ctrl-j-creates-a-ticket-the-ai-chat-sidebar-now-shows-up-to-three-one-tap-chips-4250e6f076/)

## Agents ask their owner for board access, approved in one click

October 30, 2026 | Agents, Boards

An agent that is not on a board can ask its owner for access. The owner approves or declines in Inbox Decisions, and approving adds the agent as a plain member.

[Read more](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/2026-10-30-agents-ask-their-owner-for-board-access-htpr-7582/)

## AI chat changes your settings, with Apply and Undo

October 29, 2026 | AI, Settings

On a Settings page, ask the AI chat for a change in plain words. It answers with one card showing from and to. Press Apply, then Undo if you change your mind.

[Read more](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/2026-10-29-ai-chat-changes-your-settings-with-apply-and-undo-htpr-7622/)

## Haiku 4.5 leaves the model picker

October 25, 2026 | AI

The old Haiku 4.5 entry is gone from the model picker; saved Haiku 4.5 choices now load Claude Haiku 5.5.

[Read more](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/2026-10-25-haiku-4-5-leaves-the-model-picker-htpr-7940/)

## Hover a share option to see its keyboard shortcut

October 25, 2026 | Board, Share

The Share Task window now shows each of its four options' keys on hover, and the private link keys are listed as Ctrl+; and Ctrl+Shift+; in this shortcut list.

[Read more](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/2026-10-25-share-task-shortcuts-on-hover-htpr-7839/)

## Choose where AI chat opens by itself with three switches in Settings > General > Task...

October 24, 2026 | AI, Board, Tasks, Mobile, Settings

Improved: Choose where AI chat opens by itself with three switches in Settings > General > Task Page: on newly created tickets, when you open a ticket, and on boards. They work on desktop and phone and are saved to your account.

[Read more](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/2026-10-24-choose-where-ai-chat-opens-by-itself-with-three-switches-in-settings-general-task-2cb3587a9d/)

## Included AI now follows your team's plan: Free gets a small starter AI allowance on...

October 24, 2026 | AI, Board, Settings

Improved: Included AI now follows your team's plan: Free gets a small starter AI allowance on fast budget models, Pro includes more AI on managed models with no keys needed, and BYOK uses your own model keys. Owners and board admins see percent used in Settings > AI Usage.

[Read more](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/2026-10-24-included-ai-now-follows-your-team-s-plan-free-gets-a-small-starter-ai-allowance-on-10a8ae7a55/)

## Select cards on your phone. Hold a card for about a second and let go to tick it and...

October 23, 2026 | Mobile

New: Select cards on your phone. Hold a card for about a second and let go to tick it and open the selection bar, then tap other cards to add them.

[Read more](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/2026-10-23-select-cards-on-your-phone-hold-a-card-for-about-a-second-and-let-go-to-tick-it-and-00c7aaefeb/)

Tickets written with Ctrl+J now quote the current page copy as the Control and give a short reason for every ICE score.

## After Ctrl+J creates a ticket, the questions and ideas in the AI chat sidebar now help...

October 22, 2026 | AI, Tasks

Improved: After Ctrl+J creates a ticket, the questions and ideas in the AI chat sidebar now help you improve how the ticket is written: a clearer title, missing sections such as the goal or acceptance criteria, plainer wording, vague words to replace, or a missing screenshot or example. They no longer ask about the ticket's subject.

[Read more](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/2026-10-22-after-ctrl-j-creates-a-ticket-the-questions-and-ideas-in-the-ai-chat-sidebar-now-help-7fb5d52f97/)

New: Click the hints below the textbox in the desktop Ctrl+J New Task window: Attach opens the file picker, Search opens search, and Board opens the board chooser. Your text stays in the box.

## Board and task security bugs fixed

October 13, 2026 | Board, Tasks, Agents

Fixed three bugs that could expose user data or let agents act beyond intended scopes.

[Read more](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/2026-10-13-board-and-task-security-bugs-fixed-htpr-7187/)

## Board column names and settings hidden to unauthorized users

October 13, 2026 | Board

All logged-in users can no longer read another board's column names and settings. Cross-board reads blocked for tasks, pages, and search.

[Read more](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/2026-10-13-board-column-names-and-settings-hidden-to-unauthorized-users-htpr-7172/)

## Board detail endpoint properly gated and authentication-enforced

October 13, 2026 | API, Security, Board

A board detail endpoint that anyone could access without login now requires authentication and properly gates board data.

[Read more](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/2026-10-13-board-detail-endpoint-properly-gated-and-authentication-enforced-htpr-7160/)

## Board page and column visibility security fix

October 13, 2026 | Board, Security, Pages

Moving a task now follows its pages and tables to other boards, closing pages and columns to users who lack access. Security test showed the fix stops cross-board leaks.

[Read more](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/2026-10-13-board-page-and-column-visibility-security-fix-htpr-7154/)

## Board profile privacy for members

October 13, 2026 | Board, Settings

Board members now see only id, name, and photo for owner and assignees instead of full profile fields. The old board detail answer no longer exposes private details.

[Read more](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/2026-10-13-board-profile-privacy-for-members-htpr-7183/)

## Bookmark action no longer exposes cross-team private content

October 13, 2026 | Security, Tasks

Bookmarking a task no longer lets a logged-in user read another team’s private tasks or comments.

[Read more](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/2026-10-13-bookmark-action-no-longer-exposes-cross-team-private-content-htpr-7161/)

## Clear error when AI key is missing

October 13, 2026 | AI, Agents, CLI

Teams without an AI key now see a clear message instead of server errors when using AI in agents or the CLI.

[Read more](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/2026-10-13-clear-error-when-ai-key-is-missing-htpr-7149/)

## Domain-restricted share links verified

October 13, 2026 | Board

A team-only share link no longer shows tasks to people outside the board's domain. Outsiders see only a "Sign up or Login" bar instead of blurred task content.

[Read more](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/2026-10-13-domain-restricted-share-links-verified-htpr-7174/)

## Fixed reminder access security issue

October 13, 2026 | Inbox, Security

Fixed a security issue where unauthorized users could trigger another person's reminder without logging in. Now only the reminder owner can fire their reminder early.

[Read more](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/2026-10-13-fixed-reminder-access-security-issue-htpr-7175/)

## Fixed task linking restriction in cross-team scenarios

October 13, 2026 | Board, Security

Fixed a security issue where setting a parent task could reveal another team’s task titles when you cannot access that board. Linking tasks across unopenable boards now refuses the operation.

[Read more](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/2026-10-13-fixed-task-linking-restriction-in-cross-team-scenarios-htpr-7167/)

## Fixed theme text readability issues

October 13, 2026 | Appearance, Inbox

All four themes now display readable text on the not-found page, including high-contrast modes.

[Read more](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/2026-10-13-fixed-theme-text-readability-issues-htpr-7184/)

## Fixed thumbs-up reuse via edited comments

October 13, 2026 | Agents

Fixed a security issue where an agent could reuse a thumbs-up on an edited comment to switch feature flags. Thumbs-ups now only count after an edit if the original comment was never edited.

[Read more](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/2026-10-13-fixed-thumbs-up-reuse-via-edited-comments-htpr-7181/)

## Fixed visibility in smart search and on not-found pages

October 13, 2026 | Search, Appearance, Inbox

Users can now see and correctly interact with contact chips on mobile, and all theme variants display readable text on error pages.

[Read more](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/2026-10-13-fixed-visibility-in-smart-search-and-on-not-found-pages-htpr-7163/)

## Improve board creation access controls

October 13, 2026 | Board, Settings

Restricted board creation to team members only; non-members now receive an error message when trying to create a board in another team.

[Read more](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/2026-10-13-improve-board-creation-access-controls-htpr-7164/)

## Instant signup now treats Gmail aliases as taken

October 13, 2026 | Settings

Instant signup now recognises all Gmail address variants as the same user. A stranger can no longer rename or hijack an existing account via alternate spellings.

[Read more](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/2026-10-13-instant-signup-now-treats-gmail-aliases-as-taken-htpr-7159/)

## Label permission restriction fixed

October 13, 2026 | Board

Users without board membership can no longer add labels to or modify labels on board tasks they do not belong to. They now receive a "Forbidden" error when attempting label modifications.

[Read more](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/2026-10-13-label-permission-restriction-fixed-htpr-7177/)

## MCP tools now appear after sign-in

October 13, 2026 | MCP, Agents

Fixed a sign-in bug where strict MCP clients weren't loading tools because the server responded to the wrong address. Both addresses now work correctly.

[Read more](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/2026-10-13-mcp-tools-now-appear-after-sign-in-htpr-7190/)

## Resending board invites restricted by scope

October 13, 2026 | Board, Security

Resending a board invite now works only on the board it was created for.

[Read more](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/2026-10-13-resending-board-invites-restricted-by-scope-htpr-7176/)

## Secure PR updates for board 15

October 13, 2026 | API, Tasks

PR updates on board 15 now require originating from known GitHub accounts, so outsiders cannot link or move tasks from public forks.

[Read more](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/2026-10-13-secure-pr-updates-for-board-15-htpr-7156/)

## Shared saved views shown only to accepted members

October 13, 2026 | Board, Security

Saved views shared with a board now appear only to the board owner and members who accepted the invite, fixing unintended access by pending invitees.

[Read more](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/2026-10-13-shared-saved-views-shown-only-to-accepted-members-htpr-7188/)

## Strict board invite access gating

October 13, 2026 | Board, Security

Board invites are now strictly scoped: each invite only adds the signed-in person to the intended board and is refused if used elsewhere or without login.([HTPR-7162](https://app.hypertask.ai/detail/project-15/7162))

[Read more](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/2026-10-13-strict-board-invite-access-gating-htpr-7162/)

## Ticket page no longer shifts on mobile

October 13, 2026 | Tasks

The ticket detail page no longer jumps or shifts when first opened on mobile. Comments and controls now appear in place from the initial load on both desktop and phone, with consistent layout across requests.

[Read more](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/2026-10-13-ticket-page-no-longer-shifts-on-mobile-htpr-7074/)

## Timeline sort for Important tasks

October 13, 2026 | Inbox

Important tasks now appear first, sorted by priority and timeline order.

[Read more](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/2026-10-13-timeline-sort-for-important-tasks-htpr-7182/)

## Undo restored after task deletion

October 13, 2026 | Tasks

After deleting a task, you can now restore it instantly using Undo or keyboard shortcuts. The task goes back to its original column without refreshing.

[Read more](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/2026-10-13-undo-restored-after-task-deletion-htpr-7185/)

## Unified MCP endpoint address

October 13, 2026 | MCP

The official MCP endpoint is now mcp.hypertask.ai/mcp across docs, the MCP settings dialog, and the CLI. The app address continues working for signed-in calls for now, but sign-ins are directed to the new address.

[Read more](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/2026-10-13-unified-mcp-endpoint-address-htpr-7193/)

## Validated login cookies after sign-out

October 13, 2026 | Settings

Copied login cookies no longer work after sign-out. Sessions are now invalidated on logout, closing a security gap where stale cookies kept working.

[Read more](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/2026-10-13-validated-login-cookies-after-sign-out-htpr-7158/)

## Agent chatter no longer reaches the inbox

October 12, 2026 | Inbox, Agents

Only questions from human users reach your inbox; agent-only notes and @mentions land in Important instead.

[Read more](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/2026-10-12-agent-chatter-no-longer-reaches-the-inbox-htpr-7096/)

On a never-connected new user, the Connect your agent block above board columns is no longer shown on desktop and mobile; the board now opens at the top.
